in_sanskrit.name: कामलाक्षी
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one with eyes as lotus (Kamal) and is adorned with Goddess Lakshmi's grace and prosperity (Kshi).

in_hindi.name: कामलाक्षी
in_hindi.meaning: कामला के आँगनों से दिक्कती हुई विषय, लक्ष्मी की आरोपण और सफलता से पूरा हुआ
in_hindi.long_meaning: She is the one who is facing towards the Lotus (Kamal) and is adorned with the grace and prosperity of Goddess Lakshmi (Kshi).

in_tamil.name: காமலாக்ஷி
in_tamil.meaning: ஓங்குக்கோட்டம் விடுதலையாளர், லக்ஷ்மியை அருந்தவில்லையில் ஒழுக்குப்போல் குழந்தை
in_tamil.long_meaning: She is the one who resides in the Lotus (Kamal) and is adorned with the grace and prosperity of Goddess Lakshmi (Kshi) as if she is emerging from it.

in_telugu.name: కాಮలాక్ஷி
in_telugu.long_meaning: She is the Goddess of Lotus (Kamal) and is adorned with the grace and prosperity of Goddess Lakshmi (Kshi).

in_marathi.name: Kamalakshi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lotus-Eyed, Goddess of Beauty
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kamalakshi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Kamala’ meaning lotus and ‘Akshi’ meaning eyes. Kamalakshi is a name for the goddess Lakshmi, the Hindu deity of prosperity, fortune, and wealth. She is often depicted as having lotus flowers as eyes, hence the name ‘Lotus-Eyed.’

in_bengali.name: Kamalakshi
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lotus-Eyed, Goddess of Beauty
in_bengali.long_meaning: Kamalakshi একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Kamala’ meaning lotus and ‘Akshi’ meaning eyes. Kamalakshi is a name for the goddess Lakshmi, the Hindu deity of prosperity, fortune, and wealth. She is often depicted as having lotus flowers as eyes, hence the name ‘Lotus-Eyed.’
